_comment: The rows of a run scoreboard (spec 20261113-p1v-run-scoreboard-spec.md section 2): which counter of run_counters each row reads, its unit and the direction that is better (null = no direction declared, so `worse` is never decided). Value forms: path | ratio {num, den} (percent) | diff {a, b} | sum_of/max_of + field | count_of | special price | quality. `truth_bound` rows are compared across scoreboards only for the same truth version. `pile` names the pile a worsened row's finding goes to (default_pile otherwise).
_verdicts_comment: word of a judgment verdict -> category, closed variety as data (AR-1). EMPTY on purpose: the spec names no vocabulary, so every QA row reads unknown until the Lead declares it (question in the N6 report).

T1.name: Run wall (first start to last record)

T1x.name: Run wall without operator intervention gaps

T2.name: Role model time (union of overlapping calls)

T3.name: Conductor model time not overlapped by a role

G1.name: Returns naming any one check id (the most)

Q2.name: Gates passed by the person's word

U1.name: Data quality: lines the counters could not trust

QA3.name: Owner-decides places asked or not noticed

quality.why: the judgment file (judgment/1) has no per-card red-test rows
the judgment file (judgment/1) has no per-item unverified rows
the judgment file (judgment/1) has no machine-readable verdict row

X1.name: Task price (task_price: agreement value or range)
